title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 2,701–2,750 個單字（CEFR B1 中級）

examples.en: Tech companies heavily invest in protecting valuable intellectual property (IP).
examples.zh: 科技大廠投入巨資以全面捍衛其珍貴的核心智慧財產權（IP）。

examples.en: The university established a technology transfer office to commercialize academic intellectual property.
examples.zh: 這所大學設立了技術移轉產學合作辦公室，以積極將學術智慧財產轉化為商業價值。

examples.en: Stealing corporate intellectual property can lead to devastating criminal charges and civil damages.
examples.zh: 惡意竊取企業核心智慧財產，恐將招致毀滅性的刑事罪名起訴與巨額民事損害賠償。

examples.en: All photos and articles on this blog are protected under copyright law.
examples.zh: 本部落格上刊載之所有攝影照片與專題文章皆受著作權法保護。

examples.en: The photographer registered copyright for her landscape photos to prevent unauthorized commercial usage.
examples.zh: 該攝影師為其拍攝的高山風景攝影作品登記註冊版權，以嚴防遭他人未經授權擅自商業盜用。

examples.en: Downloading movies from illegal streaming sites directly violates international copyright treaties.
examples.zh: 從非法盜版影音網站任意下載電影觀看，直接違反了國際著作權公約的嚴格規定。

examples.en: The semiconductor engineer filed a patent application for microchip packaging.
examples.zh: 半導體工程師針對創新的晶片封裝製程技術提出了專利申請。

examples.en: Holding key patents on lithium battery chemistry gives the startup a massive competitive edge.
examples.zh: 握有鋰電池化學配方的關鍵專利技術，使這家新創團隊在市場上擁有龐大且難以撼動的競爭優勢。

examples.en: The invention must be novel, useful, and non-obvious to be granted an official patent.
examples.zh: 一項發明必須具備新穎性、產業利用性以及進步性（非顯而易見性），方能順利獲頒正式發明專利。

examples.en: Registering your brand name as a trademark prevents unfair imitation.
examples.zh: 將自有品牌名稱正式登記註冊為商標能有效防範不肖同業抄襲模仿。

examples.en: The golden arches are an internationally recognized registered trademark of McDonald's.
examples.zh: 金黃色雙拱門標誌是麥當勞在全球各地廣為人知、享有高度辨識度的知名註冊商標。

examples.en: The beverage company sued a competitor for using a confusingly similar logo trademark.
examples.zh: 這家飲料大廠正式向法院控告同業競爭對手，指控其採用了極易引發消費者混淆的近似商標。

examples.en: The secret milk tea recipe is protected as a strictly confidential trade secret.
examples.zh: 該獨門奶茶調配配方被列為嚴格保密的營業秘密予以周密保護。

examples.en: Departing engineers are reminded that taking proprietary source code violates trade secret laws.
examples.zh: 人事部門再三提醒即將離職的工程師，私自攜帶公司專屬原始碼將觸犯營業秘密保護法。

examples.en: Coca-Cola's legendary beverage formula is perhaps the world's most famously guarded trade secret.
examples.zh: 可口可樂流傳百年的傳奇飲料原汁配方，堪稱全世界保密最為嚴密且最負盛名的營業秘密。

examples.en: Unauthorized music downloads constitute copyright infringement.
examples.zh: 未經合法授權任意下載商業音樂檔案已構成嚴重的著作權侵權違法。

examples.en: The electronics maker was ordered to pay twenty million dollars for willful patent infringement.
examples.zh: 這家電器製造商因被法院認定蓄意惡意侵害他人專利，被判決須連帶賠償兩千萬美元。

examples.en: Using famous cartoon characters on product packaging without permission is trademark infringement.
examples.zh: 未經原廠書面授權便私自將知名動漫卡通角色印在商品包裝盒上，已屬嚴重的商標侵權。

examples.en: Copying source code directly may infringe upon third-party copyrights.
examples.zh: 直接複製貼上開源軟體原始碼可能會侵害第三方的軟體著作權。

examples.en: The new smartphone design was carefully reviewed to ensure it does not infringe on existing patents.
examples.zh: 這款新推出的智慧型旗艦手機外觀經過律師嚴密審查，確保其絕未侵犯同業現存的設計專利。

examples.en: Citizens protested that the excessive surveillance cameras infringe upon their constitutional right to privacy.
examples.zh: 廣大市民群起上街抗議，質疑街頭廣設過密的人臉辨識監視器恐將嚴重侵犯憲法賦予人民的隱私權。

examples.en: Customs officers confiscated thousands of counterfeit luxury leather handbags.
examples.zh: 海關查驗官員當場查扣了數千件企圖闖關的仿冒名牌精品皮包。

examples.en: Modern banknotes incorporate sophisticated holographic watermarks to deter counterfeit money.
examples.zh: 現代中央銀行發行的各國紙幣均融入了極其精密的雷射防偽水印技術，以嚴密防範偽造假鈔。

examples.en: Selling counterfeit prescription medicine online is a dangerous crime that jeopardizes human life.
examples.zh: 在網路上兜售假冒的處方劣藥屬於嚴重危害他人生命安全的重特大犯罪行為。

examples.en: Digital piracy undermines the livelihood of musicians, authors, and artists.
examples.zh: 數位網路盜版猖獗嚴重損害了音樂人、作家與藝術家的正當生計。

examples.en: The film studio implemented robust encryption software to combat online video piracy.
examples.zh: 電影製片大廠導入了強悍嚴密的水印加密軟體技術，以全力打擊猖獗的網路影音盜版行為。

examples.en: Armed international naval patrols protect commercial cargo ships against maritime piracy in the gulf.
examples.zh: 各國海軍荷槍實彈的聯合巡邏艦隊在海灣水域嚴密巡弋，全力護衛商用貨輪免遭海上武裝海盜洗劫。

words.definition: 合理使用原則（著作權法）

examples.en: Quoting a brief passage for academic educational review falls under fair use.
examples.zh: 為了學術教育評論目的節錄引用簡短文章段落符合合理使用原則。

examples.en: The documentary filmmaker relied on fair use principles to include short archival news clips.
examples.zh: 紀錄片導演依據著作權法的合理使用原則，在影片中穿插引用了幾段珍貴的歷史新聞檔案片段。

examples.en: Claiming fair use does not automatically protect you if you reproduce an entire artistic illustration.
examples.zh: 若您未經許可便將他人的完整藝術插畫全文全圖轉載，主張合理使用原則往往無法在法庭上站得住腳。

examples.en: Works by classical authors entered the public domain and can be freely used.
examples.zh: 古典古代作家的傳世著作已進入公有領域，大眾皆可自由免費用於創作。

examples.en: Once the seventy-year copyright protection term expires, creative works enter the public domain.
examples.zh: 一旦創作者逝世後七十年的著作權法定保護年限屆滿，原創作品即正式回歸進入公共領域。

examples.en: The game developer utilized public domain orchestral recordings for the background soundtrack.
examples.zh: 這家獨立遊戲開發團隊在自製遊戲的背景配樂中，大量運用了已進入公共領域的古典交響樂錄音。

words.definition: 授權協議；軟體使用授權合約

examples.en: Read the software license agreement before installing the computer program.
examples.zh: 在電腦安裝應用程式前，請務必先詳細閱讀軟體使用授權合約條款。

examples.en: Commercial enterprises must purchase a multi-seat license agreement to deploy the software legally.
examples.zh: 商業公司行號必須依規定採購多用戶數的企業授權協議，方能在內部電腦上合法部署該專業軟體。

examples.en: The patent license agreement grants the overseas factory exclusive manufacturing rights for five years.
examples.zh: 這份專利技術授權合約正式賦予該海外代工廠長達五年的獨家特定產品製造代理權。

examples.en: Songwriters receive quarterly music royalties each time their songs stream.
examples.zh: 詞曲創作人每當其原創歌曲在串流平台被播放時，每季皆可收取音樂版稅。

examples.en: The publishing house paid the best-selling author a 15% royalty on all paperback book sales.
examples.zh: 這家知名出版大社按合約向該名暢銷作家支付了每本實體平裝書定價一成五的版稅酬勞。

examples.en: Members of the British royalty attended the prestigious charity gala in London last night.
examples.zh: 英國皇室家族的多位主要核心成員於昨晚親臨出席了在倫敦舉行的年度盛大慈善晚宴。

examples.en: Sign an NDA before reviewing the confidential project architecture plans.
examples.zh: 在查閱這份高度機密的專案系統架構圖之前，雙方必須先簽署保密協定。

examples.en: Both corporate parties signed a mutual NDA to ensure trade secrets remain strictly confidential during talks.
examples.zh: 雙方企業代表在正式展開策略結盟洽談前簽署了雙向互惠 NDA，確保所有商業機密絕不外流。

examples.en: Leaking prototype product specifications violates the legally binding NDA you signed upon joining the company.
examples.zh: 私自外洩未公開原型機的規格參數，已直接違反了您在入職報到當天所親筆簽署的法定保密協議。

examples.en: Employees must uphold strict confidentiality regarding customer personal data.
examples.zh: 全體員工皆必須恪遵嚴格的保密義務，絕不外洩任何客戶個人隱私資料。

examples.en: Doctors and psychologists are bound by medical ethics to maintain absolute patient confidentiality.
examples.zh: 執業主治醫師與臨床心理諮商師受制於崇高醫療倫理規範，負有維繫病患病情絕對隱私與保密責任。

examples.en: Breaching client confidentiality can result in immediate termination of employment and legal sanctions.
examples.zh: 嚴重背棄與外洩客戶委託機密資料者，將面臨立即遭到公司開除解雇以及隨之而來的司法嚴厲制裁。

words.definition: 合約條款；款項；文法子句

examples.en: Review the liability limitation clause in the service agreement carefully.
examples.zh: 仔細審閱該服務提供協議書中關於損害賠償責任限制的合約條款。

examples.en: The contract includes an arbitration clause specifying that all disputes must be resolved in Taipei.
examples.zh: 該商業合約中特別增設了一道強制仲裁條款，載明雙方未來一切履約紛爭均須提交台北仲裁機構裁決。

examples.en: The employer inserted a non-compete clause that restricts departing staff from joining competitors for one year.
examples.zh: 資方在勞動合約中特別載入競業禁止條款，嚴格限制離職員工在離職後一年內不得投奔同業競品公司。

examples.en: Check the box to agree to the platform's terms and conditions.
examples.zh: 請勾選方框以表示您已閱讀並完全同意該平台的使用者服務條款。

examples.en: Users rarely read the lengthy terms and conditions before downloading modern smartphone apps.
examples.zh: 絕大多數使用者在下載安裝智慧手機 App 之前，極少有耐心完整逐字閱讀那些冗長的使用條款。

examples.en: The bank revised its credit card terms and conditions to clarify overseas transaction fees.
examples.zh: 發卡銀行全面修訂了信用卡會員權益使用條款細則，進一步釐清海外跨國刷卡手續費的計費標準。

examples.en: The updated privacy policy explains how user cookie tracking data is utilized.
examples.zh: 最新修訂的隱私權政策清楚說明了網站將如何妥善運用使用者 Cookie。

examples.en: Global data protection laws mandate that every website display an easily accessible privacy policy.
examples.zh: 國際個資保護法規明文要求，任何商業營利網站都必須在首頁顯著版位提供直觀易閱的隱私權政策。

examples.en: Parents should review the privacy policy before allowing their young children to play online games.
examples.zh: 家長在允許年幼孩童註冊遊玩連線線上遊戲之前，應當審慎檢閱該遊戲平台所公告的個人隱私保護政策。

examples.en: Failing to deliver goods on the agreed date constitutes a contract breach.
examples.zh: 未能在約定期限內如期交付商品已構成了實質上的違約行為。

examples.en: A catastrophic data breach exposed the private passwords of over ten million online accounts.
examples.zh: 一起災難性的重大資料外洩資安事件，導致超過一千萬筆線上註冊帳戶的私密密碼慘遭公開洩露。

examples.en: The military commander was court-martialed for committing a serious breach of official discipline.
examples.zh: 該名軍事指揮官因涉嫌嚴重違反軍隊內部保密與操守軍紀，隨即被移送軍法機關依法接受軍法審判。

examples.en: Either party may terminate the lease by giving a thirty-day advance written notice.
examples.zh: 租賃雙方任一方均可於三十天前以書面通知對方提前解除租約。

examples.en: The company decided to terminate the problematic distributor's exclusive sales contract.
examples.zh: 鑑於該經銷商履約狀況頻出且信譽堪憂，該公司最終毅然決定提前終止其獨家經銷總代理合約。

examples.en: The contractor's failure to meet safety standards prompted the government to terminate the project immediately.
examples.zh: 承包營造商多次未能通過關鍵公共安全檢測，促使主管機關當機立斷、立即依法終止了該工程專案。

words.definition: 有效的；合法成立的；有根據的

examples.en: A contract is legally valid only when signed by authorized representatives.
examples.zh: 一份商業合約唯有在獲得授權代表親筆簽署後方具備合法效力。

examples.en: You must present a valid government-issued photo ID to board the domestic flight.
examples.zh: 您在登機搭乘國內線航班前，必須在櫃檯出示由政府機關依法核發且在有效期限內的個人身分證件。

examples.en: The research scientist raised several valid objections to the proposed experimental methodology.
examples.zh: 這位權威研究科學家針對該項被提議的實驗研究方法論，極具洞察力地提出了數點非常有力的質疑。

examples.en: If signed under fraud or threat, the signed agreement is declared null and void.
examples.zh: 若是在遭受詐欺或脅迫下所簽署的協議，依法宣告自始無效。

examples.en: The judge ruled that the disputed testamentary will was null and void due to lack of witnesses.
examples.zh: 承審法官認定該份引起家族遺產紛爭的自書遺囑因欠缺合法見證人簽名，依法裁定自始完全無效。

examples.en: Altering numbers on a certified bank check without authorization makes the instrument null and void.
examples.zh: 未經授權擅自塗改受銀行認證支票上的受款金額數字，將直接導致該張法定票據瞬間作廢且毫無效力。

examples.en: Both electronic signatures and handwritten seals create legally binding agreements.
examples.zh: 不論是數位電子簽章還是實體印鑑用印，皆能產生具法律約束力的契約。

examples.en: Although verbal agreements can be considered legally binding, proving their exact terms in court is notoriously difficult.
examples.zh: 儘管口頭承諾在法律上亦可能被認定具備法律拘束力，但在法庭上舉證其確切條款內容卻極度困難。

examples.en: Once ratified by parliament, international climate treaties become legally binding national commitments.
examples.zh: 跨國氣候公約一旦獲得國會議會正式三讀批准生效，即成為該國依法必須履行且具法律效力的承諾。

examples.en: The airline accepts limited liability for lost or damaged luggage.
examples.zh: 航空公司對於託運行李在運送過程中的遺失或損壞承擔有限的賠償責任。

examples.en: Buying comprehensive insurance protects business owners from enormous premises liability claims.
examples.zh: 投保足額的商業綜合責任保險，能讓中小企業雇主免於承受突發公共場所意外帶來的巨額賠償訴求。

examples.en: In business accounting, mortgages and unpaid invoices are classified as long-term or current liabilities.
examples.zh: 在企業財務會計學中，各類不動產房屋抵押借款與待結清應付帳款，均被嚴格歸類為長期或流動負債。

words.definition: 負有法律責任的；應負責的

examples.en: The careless driver is held fully liable for all vehicle repair costs.
examples.zh: 該名疏忽肇事的駕駛人被依法判定須承擔全部車輛修繕賠償責任。

examples.en: Under product safety regulations, manufacturers are strictly liable for injuries caused by defective designs.
examples.zh: 依據現行消費者保護法規，製造大廠對於因產品先天設計不良瑕疵所釀成的消費者人身傷害負有嚴格責任。

examples.en: In rainy weather, mountain highways are liable to sudden rockfalls and landslides.
examples.zh: 在梅雨連綿或豪大雨來襲時，高山落石多發路段的公路極易發生無預警的邊坡崩塌與致命落石。

examples.en: The company filed a civil lawsuit against the former partner for trade secret theft.
examples.zh: 該公司針對前合夥人涉嫌竊取商業機密之行為正式向法院提起民事訴訟。

examples.en: The consumer protection association launched a class-action lawsuit on behalf of injured passengers.
examples.zh: 消費者文教基金會代表受害全體旅客，正式向交通運送業者發起了大規模的集體民事訴訟求償。

examples.en: Settling out of court avoided a lengthy and prohibitively expensive corporate lawsuit.
examples.zh: 雙方律師在法庭之外達成庭外和解協議，避免了一場曠日費時且代價極其高昂的跨國企業訴訟大戰。

examples.en: The author threatened to sue the publisher over unpaid royalties.
examples.zh: 該名作家因出版社長期積欠版稅而揚言將正式委任律師依法提告。

examples.en: If you slip and fall on an icy sidewalk due to commercial negligence, you can sue for medical damages.
examples.zh: 若您因商家的嚴重疏失在結冰未清理的人行道上滑倒受傷，依法完全可以向店家提告求償醫療費用。

examples.en: The investor hired a law firm to sue the dishonest founders for securities fraud.
examples.zh: 這名受害投資人專門委任知名律師事務所，依法向涉嫌發布假財報惡意吸金的創辦團隊提告證券詐欺。

examples.en: The plaintiff presented solid written evidence to support their claim.
examples.zh: 原告律師向法庭呈交了確鑿詳實的書面物證以佐證其主張。

examples.en: The burden of proof in civil lawsuits typically rests upon the plaintiff.
examples.zh: 在一般的民事侵權賠償訴訟中，基本的舉證法律責任通常依法由提告的原告一方負擔。

examples.en: After hearing arguments from both sides, the jury awarded substantial monetary compensation to the injured plaintiff.
examples.zh: 在詳細聆聽雙方法律攻防答辯後，民事陪審團做出了裁定被告須向受害原告支付巨額損害賠償金的決定。

examples.en: The defendant pleaded not guilty to all charges during the initial hearing.
examples.zh: 被告在初次開庭審訊程序中針對檢方所起訴之罪名全數抗辯無罪。

examples.en: The public defender worked tirelessly to prepare an alibi defense for the indigent defendant.
examples.zh: 公設辯護人日以繼夜全力奔走，悉心為這名無力聘請大律師的貧困刑事被告搜集完整的不在場證明。

examples.en: Throughout the televised courtroom trial, the defendant remained completely silent and expressionless.
examples.zh: 在整場電視新聞全程轉播的法庭公開審理過程中，端坐在被告席上的被告始終緊抿雙唇且面無表情。

examples.en: Consult with a qualified corporate attorney before signing international joint ventures.
examples.zh: 在簽署跨國合資企業合約前，請先諮詢合格專業的企業商務律師。

examples.en: The defense attorney delivered a passionate closing argument to convince the jurors.
examples.zh: 刑事辯護律師在法庭上發表了一段慷慨激昂、邏輯縝密的結案陳詞，極力說服全體陪審員相信被告。

examples.en: She granted her trusted elder brother full power of attorney to manage her financial assets.
examples.zh: 她在出國定居前正式簽署了法律授權書，全權委託深得她信賴的兄長作為法定代理人代為處分資產。

examples.en: The public prosecutor indicted the suspects on charges of financial fraud.
examples.zh: 地檢署檢察官依涉犯重大金融詐欺取財罪嫌將全案被告提起公訴。

examples.en: The district prosecutor called several key forensic witnesses to the stand to testify.
examples.zh: 地檢署承辦公訴檢察官在法庭上傳喚了數名關鍵法醫鑑識專家輪流出庭具結作證。

examples.en: Prosecutors must prove guilt beyond a reasonable doubt to secure a criminal conviction.
examples.zh: 刑事檢察官肩負舉證責任，必須提出毫無合理懷疑的確鑿鐵證，方能在法庭上成功定罪被告。

examples.en: The dispute was resolved through judicial settlement inside the Taipei District Court.
examples.zh: 該起民事爭議最終在台北地方法院法庭內透過司法和解圓滿落幕。

examples.en: The witness swore an oath on the Bible to tell nothing but the truth in open court.
examples.zh: 出庭證人在法官面前將手輕按於聖經上莊嚴宣誓，保證在公開法庭上所陳述之證言絕無虛言。

examples.en: After playing tennis on the clay court, the athletes rested at the clubhouse.
examples.zh: 在紅土球場上揮汗如雨打完一場激烈的網球單打比賽後，運動員們紛紛移步至俱樂部會館內放鬆休息。

examples.en: Every accused citizen is entitled to a speedy, public, and fair trial.
examples.zh: 每一位遭受起訴的國民皆享有獲得迅速、公開且公正審判的憲法權利。

examples.en: The high-profile murder trial lasted for three grueling months before reaching a final verdict.
examples.zh: 這場引發全社會高度關注的重大殺人案法庭審判，在歷經整整三個月緊繃審理後方才迎來最終判決。

examples.en: The biopharmaceutical company launched Phase 3 clinical trials to test the efficacy of the new cancer vaccine.
examples.zh: 該生技製藥巨擘正式展開第三期大規模人體臨床試驗，以驗證這款革命性新型抗癌疫苗的真實療效。

examples.en: The legislative committee scheduled a public hearing on AI safety regulations.
examples.zh: 立法委員會安排召開了一場關於人工智慧安全法規的公聽會聽證會。

examples.en: The judge scheduled a bail hearing for tomorrow morning to decide whether the suspect can be released.
examples.zh: 承審法官裁定於明晨九時準時召開保釋審查庭，以審慎研議評估是否准予涉案重大嫌疑人交保候傳。

examples.en: Regular medical audiometry tests help detect early signs of occupational hearing loss in noisy factories.
examples.zh: 定期接受醫院耳鼻喉科專業聽力檢測，有助於早期察覺並防範在吵雜高噪音工廠環境中的職業性聽力受損。

examples.en: The eye-witness gave a detailed testimony regarding the traffic collision.
examples.zh: 現場目擊證人就這起車禍擦撞經過向承辦員警提供了詳盡的目擊證詞。

examples.en: She signed as an official legal witness on the couple's marriage certificate.
examples.zh: 她作為法定具名證人，鄭重在這對新婚佳偶的官方結婚登記證書上親筆簽名見證。

examples.en: Travelers who hike to the summit at dawn can witness the spectacular sunrise over the Sea of Clouds.
examples.zh: 凡是在破曉清晨克服嚴寒徒步登頂的高山旅人，皆能親眼目睹阿里山壯麗雲海日出翻湧的震撼奇景。

examples.en: The expert witness's forensic testimony proved crucial to the judge's decision.
examples.zh: 鑑識鑑識專家的專業證詞對承審法官的最終判決發揮了關鍵影響。

examples.en: The victim delivered a deeply emotional testimony recounting the traumatic home invasion robbery.
examples.zh: 受害當事人在法庭上發表了真情流露且令人動容的親身證詞，字字血淚回憶那場驚悚的入室搶劫。

examples.en: The dramatic turnaround of the struggling brand stands as a shining testimony to the team's resilience.
examples.zh: 這家一度瀕臨破產的老字號品牌成功浴火重生的大逆轉，正是團隊堅韌不拔精神的最佳有力見證。

examples.en: The prosecutor submitted surveillance camera footage as concrete direct evidence.
examples.zh: 檢察官向法官呈交了監視器錄影畫面作為最直接有力的關鍵物證。

examples.en: Without sufficient physical evidence linking the suspect to the crime scene, the police had to release him.
examples.zh: 由於缺乏充足且不可動搖的現場生物物證將嫌疑人與犯罪現場鎖定，警方依法只能將其暫時釋放。

examples.en: Archaeological excavations uncovered fascinating evidence of prehistoric civilization in eastern Taiwan.
examples.zh: 考古團隊在台灣東部遺址發掘出驚人且珍貴的石器物證，有力印證了史前人類古老文明在此繁衍生息。

examples.en: The judge pronounced a guilty verdict after evaluating all evidence.
examples.zh: 法官在全面審酌各項調查證據後，當庭宣判了有罪判決。

examples.en: The jury spent three full days deliberating before finally delivering a unanimous not-guilty verdict.
examples.zh: 陪審團在閉門密室中歷經長達三整天的激烈評議交鋒，最終做出了全體一致無罪判決的歷史性裁定。

examples.en: The verdict of market history shows that companies that resist technological change inevitably fall behind.
examples.zh: 商業市場演進史的無情公斷早已證明：任何冥頑不靈抗拒科技創新浪潮的企業，最終必然慘遭淘汰。

examples.en: The accused admitted mistakes and agreed to plead guilty in court.
examples.zh: 被告當庭坦承犯行並同意向法官認罪以爭取從輕量刑。

examples.en: The jury found the corporate executive guilty of insider stock trading and money laundering.
examples.zh: 陪審團一致裁定該名企業高階主管被控內線炒作股票與跨國洗錢罪名全部有罪成立。

examples.en: He felt terribly guilty about forgetting his mother's birthday dinner celebration.
examples.zh: 他因為忙於公事而完全遺忘了母親六十歲大壽的家庭慶生聚餐，內心感到無比自責與深切愧疚。

words.definition: 清白的；無罪的；天真無邪的

examples.en: Under the rule of law, every defendant is presumed innocent until proven guilty.
examples.zh: 在現代法治精神下，任何被告在未經判決確定有罪前均推定為無罪。

examples.en: DNA testing decades after the trial proved that the imprisoned man was completely innocent.
examples.zh: 在判決入獄數十年後所採用的現代高科技 DNA 重新鑑定，鐵證如山地證明了該名服刑男子是完全清白無罪的。

examples.en: Don't be so naive and innocent as to believe every investment promise you read on social media.
examples.zh: 切莫過於天真無邪，千萬不要傻傻輕信在社群網路上所看到的高報酬零風險各類虛假投資謊言。

examples.en: The defense lawyer decided to appeal the conviction to the High Court.
examples.zh: 辯護律師決定就一審判決向高等法院依法提起第二審上訴。

examples.en: The mayor made an urgent televised appeal asking citizens to stay indoors during the severe typhoon.
examples.zh: 市長在電視現場直播中發表了措辭懇切的緊急呼籲，強烈敦請全體市民在強烈颱風過境期間切勿出門。

examples.en: Minimalist interior design with natural wood elements holds timeless aesthetic appeal for young buyers.
examples.zh: 融入大量溫潤天然原木質感的現代極簡室內設計風格，對年輕世代首購族群具有歷久彌新的美學吸引力。

examples.en: The convicted fraudster received a five-year prison sentence.
examples.zh: 經判決定讞的詐欺犯被依法判處有期徒刑五年之宣告刑。

examples.en: The judge will officially pronounce sentence on the convicted embezzler next Friday.
examples.zh: 承審法官定於下週五上午正式對這名挪用公款被定罪的貪污犯開庭宣判最終刑期。

examples.en: Please write a complete, grammatically correct sentence using the newly learned vocabulary word.
examples.zh: 請運用剛在課堂上學會的全新英文單字，在作業本上造出一個結構完整且符合文法規範的句子。

examples.en: The first-time offender was granted two years of probation and community service.
examples.zh: 初犯被告獲得法官給予宣告緩刑兩年並須配合執行義務勞務。

examples.en: If the convict violates any terms of probation, he will be sent directly to state prison.
examples.zh: 該名受刑人若在法定緩刑期間內違反任何行為規範或再犯，其緩刑將被撤銷並直接發監執行徒刑。

examples.en: Newly hired engineers are placed on a three-month probation period before receiving permanent contracts.
examples.zh: 新進錄取的軟體研發工程師均必須通過長達三個月的在職試用期考核，方能正式簽署全職聘用合約。

words.definition: 罰金；罰鍰；處以罰款；好的

examples.en: Drivers who run red lights face a heavy traffic fine.
examples.zh: 汽機車駕駛人闖紅燈者將面臨交通違規高額行政罰鍰。

examples.en: The environmental protection bureau slapped the chemical plant with a massive fine for discharging untreated wastewater.
examples.zh: 環保局針對這家涉嫌私自暗管偷排未經處理有毒工業廢水的化學工廠，祭出了破紀錄的高額巨額重罰。

examples.en: We enjoyed a leisurely walk through the park under fine, clear autumn weather.
examples.zh: 在秋高氣爽、萬里無雲的晴朗好天氣下，我們一家人在市區生態公園的林蔭小徑上愜意漫步散心。

examples.en: The national constitution guarantees fundamental human rights and freedoms.
examples.zh: 國家根本大法憲法保障全體國民享有基本人權與各項自由權利。

examples.en: Any newly enacted parliamentary law that conflicts with the constitution is deemed void.
examples.zh: 任何由立法機關制定通過之法律若與憲法最高位階原則發生牴觸，依法自始宣告無效。

examples.en: Engaging in regular physical exercise and eating a balanced diet helps strengthen your bodily constitution.
examples.zh: 堅持養成規律運動的良好習慣並攝取營養均衡的原型食物，有助於從根本上強健個人的生理體質。

examples.en: Civic education empowers citizens to actively protect their democratic civil rights.
examples.zh: 公民教育賦予人民積極站出來捍衛自身民主公民權利的能力與自覺。

examples.en: Leaders like Martin Luther King Jr. fought tirelessly to secure equal civil rights for all citizens.
examples.zh: 如馬丁·路德·金恩等偉大民權領袖，傾盡畢生心血日夜奮戰，只為替全體人民爭取平等的公民權利。

examples.en: Discriminating against job applicants based on gender or race directly violates basic civil rights statutes.
examples.zh: 在求職招聘審查中基於性別、年齡或種族身分對求職者進行不公正差別待遇，公然踐踏了基本公民權益保障法。

examples.en: Respecting human rights and dignity is the cornerstone of democratic society.
examples.zh: 尊重基本人權與人性尊嚴是健全民主法治社會不可動搖的基石。

examples.en: International organizations send human rights observers to inspect conditions in foreign refugee camps.
examples.zh: 聯合國等國際人權組織常年指派獨立人權觀察員，親赴戰亂海外難民營實地嚴密稽查人道生活處境。

examples.en: Ensuring access to clean drinking water, education, and healthcare is a fundamental human rights objective.
examples.zh: 確保偏鄉與邊緣弱勢群體享有純淨飲用水、基礎義務教育以及健全醫療照護，是普世基本人權的核心目標。

examples.en: Freedom of speech allows citizens to express diverse opinions without fear.
examples.zh: 言論自由保障全體人民在無所畏懼的環境下自由抒發多元觀點。

examples.en: While the constitution protects freedom of speech, it does not protect hate speech that incites violence.
examples.zh: 儘管國家憲法最高原則誓死捍衛全民言論自由，但此項自由絕不涵蓋煽動實體暴力與仇恨言論的違法行徑。

examples.en: Independent journalists rely on robust protections for freedom of speech to expose government corruption.
examples.zh: 秉持良知的獨立調查記者仰賴國家法律對言論自由的堅固保護，方能無所畏懼地深度揭露官商勾結貪腐弊案。

examples.en: Citizens cast ballots in the national referendum to decide important public policies.
examples.zh: 廣大公民在全國性公投中投下神聖一票以共同決定重大公共政策走向。

examples.en: The municipal government scheduled a referendum to let island residents vote on the construction of the bridge.
examples.zh: 縣市政府特別安排舉行了一場地方性公民投票，由全體離島鄉親自主公決跨海大橋的興建方案。

examples.en: The constitutional amendment will be put forward for approval in a nationwide referendum next winter.
examples.zh: 這項涉及重大憲制調整的憲法修正案，將於明年入冬之際正式交付全民公投進行最後的民意批准。

examples.en: Lawmakers passed new data protection legislation to safeguard consumer privacy.
examples.zh: 立法人員三讀通過了全新的個人資料保護法規以周全捍衛消費者隱私。

examples.en: Stricter legislation regarding drunk driving has drastically reduced fatal road accidents nationwide.
examples.zh: 針對酒後駕車違法行為制定更為嚴厲苛刻的懲處修法，極為有效地大幅降低了全國各地的致命交通事故。

examples.en: Drafting clear and unambiguous environmental legislation requires extensive collaboration with scientific experts.
examples.zh: 起草字句嚴謹且毫無模糊解釋空間的環保法案法規，需要與各領域頂尖環境科學專家展開深度的通力合作。
